title: Founder Console source-of-truth audit and route decision
goal: Record the exact existing auth, CRM, scheduling, trial, follow-up, payment, media-task and event contracts needed by the console, with a decisive app placement plan.

title: Founder-only same-origin console route and secure app boundary
goal: A founder may reach a protected console shell at the chosen path, while everyone else is denied at both render and API access layers.

title: Truthful console read models and verified weekly-hours metric
goal: Panel queries return minimal authorized, provenance-rich data and never display fabricated metrics.

title: Cinematic command-bridge shell and scalable instrument kit
goal: Create a beautiful responsive console shell matching the approved concept, with semantic reusable data surfaces and no hardcoded fictional business results.

title: Sales radar and prioritised next-lead Rolodex
goal: Give the founder a real next-best-person-to-call view that retains unresolved leads and explains prioritization.

title: Explicit call outcomes, next-action follow-ups and safe queue progression
goal: After a real call, the founder can explicitly record a truthful result and scheduled follow-up in the existing authoritative system, then advance the Rolodex.

title: Teacher load, trial funnel, verified financial readouts and delivery gaps
goal: Make staffing availability, trial outcomes, lesson-log gaps and payment verification visually inspectable without assuming unverified facts.

title: Creation mode backed by the existing marketing work system
goal: A clear creation-mode queue surfaces scripts, filming, edits and the weekly media review without making a second CMS.

title: Event-backed actionable signals, interruption policy and integration health
goal: Surface newly actionable leads and actual operational exceptions without false always-on surveillance or interruptions during teaching.

title: Visual fidelity, accessible operation and founder release acceptance
goal: Harden the finished bridge, prove it is both beautiful and truthful, and prepare it for a founder-controlled launch.
